description: If \(F\subseteq G\) are finite atom sets, restriction to \(F\) of an allowed assignment on \(G\) is an allowed assignment on \(F\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.allowed_rows_restrict.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α) (F G : Finset α) (hFG : F ⊆ G) (r : ↥G → Bool)
  (hr : r ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.AllowedRows Γ G) :
  (fun i => r (Set.inclusion hFG i)) ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.AllowedRows Γ F
